source: Triodian project note 'United States - jurisdiction scope (US.1)' and the Atlas US round (data/research/2026-11-14-us-overlay.json in obligations-atlas). The documents and arrangement types are what a US entity in the sector usually holds and has; whether an instrument applies is counsel's question, and the matter brief lists the records.

packs.name: Bank (United States)
packs.instruments: SR 26-2 on model risk, the 2023 interagency third-party guidance and, in New York, 23 NYCRR 500

documents.D3: Register of third-party relationships, with those that support critical activities marked, and their subcontractors
documents.D9: Existing assurance over the arrangements: audit reports, control reports, certifications, and validation reports for vendor models

packs.arrangement: The {entity} and a third party under a business arrangement: a service provider, a fintech partner, an agent or a broker

packs.name: Insurer (United States)
packs.instruments: the NAIC model bulletin on AI systems as each state has issued it and, in New York, Insurance Circular Letter No. 7

documents.D3: Register of third-party AI systems and data vendors, managing general agents and third-party administrators
documents.D5: The agreement for each arrangement, with schedules and service descriptions, including any audit rights and terms on cooperating with regulatory inquiries

packs.arrangement: The {entity} and a third party: a managing general agent, a third-party administrator, or a vendor of AI systems or external data

packs.name: Broker-dealer or investment adviser (United States)
packs.instruments: Regulation S-P, FINRA Rule 3110 and FINRA's 2026 report on generative AI and AI agents

documents.D2: AI governance framework, acceptable-use policy and the written supervisory procedures that cover generative AI and AI agents
documents.D5: The agreement for each arrangement, with schedules and service descriptions, including its terms on notice of a breach of customer information

packs.arrangement: The {entity} and a service provider that receives, maintains or processes customer information, or the vendor of an AI tool registered staff use

packs.name: Health care provider (United States)
packs.instruments: 45 CFR 92.210 on patient care decision support tools, the HIPAA business associate terms and the HTI-5 changes to certified health IT

documents.D3: Register of business associates and other providers
documents.D5: The agreement for each arrangement, including the business associate agreement, with schedules and service descriptions
documents.D7: Any provider disclosure about AI use already received, including the source and known limits of each predictive tool in the electronic health record

packs.arrangement: The {entity} and a business associate: a vendor that creates, receives, maintains or transmits patient information for it

packs.name: Critical infrastructure owner or operator (United States)
packs.instruments: NERC CIP-013 supply chain risk management (bulk electric system) and CIRCIA incident and ransom-payment reporting once its final rule is in force

documents.D3: Vendor register and the supply chain cyber security risk management plan
documents.D8: Licence terms, security documentation and remote-access arrangements for each external AI service and tool

packs.arrangement: The {entity} and a vendor of products or services for its operational systems, including any with remote access
